name: Dino Jungle
blurb: T-Rex against Stegosaurus. Footprints, plates and bamboo.
status: CANDIDATE, not approved. Colors and geometry are final; kept as a second theme option. Screens 4b in the design file.
note: Same construction rules as Robot Workshop: flat saturated fills, a 3-4px #10382a outline on every element, solid offset drop shadows, chunky radii, 700-weight type. Replaces the rejected 'Dino Dig' attempt (turn 3), which was muddy and unreadable.

playerOne.name: T-Rex footprint
playerOne.build: a 20-point clip-path polygon: three claw-tipped toes over a rounded pad, in #ff8a1e over a #10382a silhouette 2px larger

playerTwo.name: Stegosaurus plate
playerTwo.build: clip-path polygon(50% 0,90% 32%,76% 100%,24% 100%,10% 32%) in #7b5cf6 over a #10382a pentagon 2.5px larger, plus a soft white-50% rounded highlight on the upper left

catGame.name: mud puddle
catGame.build: two overlapping brown radial-gradients (#966e46, #604428) on #7a5a3a, with a 700-weight 11px MUD label in #fff3e0
catGame.label: MUD

board.smallGridLines: 3px #27865c rounded bars, inset 7% from each end, with a 1px white-30% lit edge — vines
board.bigGridLines: 12px bamboo poles laid ACROSS the gaps (never touching a quadrant): linear-gradient(#9bbd3a,#d6e86a 40%,#bcd352 70%,#8aa832), 0 0 0 2.5px #10382a, radius 5, positioned at 32.8% and 67.2%, each carrying 1-2 darker node bands at irregular offsets

controls.buttonSecondary: linear-gradient(180deg,#9b7ffb,#6f4de8), text #fff, same outline and shadow, radius 18
controls.scoreChip: #fff8e3, radius 13, 0 0 0 3px #10382a + 0 4px 0 #10382a; the active player's chip swaps to their color
controls.titlePlate: #0f3d2c, radius 20 — dark so the #ffa645 wordmark clears contrast

copy.voice: Short, loud, kid-facing. Players are named by dinosaur.

animation.note: Same timings as Neon; character is heavy and bouncy.

contrastNotes: The wordmark plate is dark green, not cream. #ff8a1e on cream measured 2.22:1.
Labels on the orange chip use near-black of the hue, not white — white measured 2.36:1.
Mid-green on cream must be #18664a or darker; #27865c measured 4.25:1 and just missed.
